entry.focal: The near stone lanterns. The cable station (hero) is a small brown box in the mid-distance, unlit except by two tiny lantern cubes. No cabin and no cable line rise to the summit.
entry.next_visible: Some: the lantern row recedes east. The hall facade on the left is a black wall, and the banners are invisible.

reveal.focal: Dark cliff face against the sky. The camera points up at z 30, where nothing exists yet; the hero is only an orange corner at the bottom right.

concept.focal: A group of white lantern boxes in the foreground (lights3, lights4) over a dark slab. The pools below show as a single teal sliver; the stepped teal terraces of 01 are not visible.
concept.next_visible: Barely: the overlook stair down is not legible.

strip.focal: Frames 0-3 the cable station box (one hanging lantern floats over the walk in frame 3). Frames 4-7 are two even parallel lines of lanterns receding into darkness for 60 m.
strip.next_visible: The far east lookout is never marked by anything brighter than the rows.

fixes.detail: The ring radius of 4.2 m exceeds the 5 by 6 m station's half-size, so the 4 'eave' lanterns float about 1.2 m outside the roof at z 3.2. Strip-3 shows one hanging in mid-air over the spine. Use radius 2.6-3.0 with snap 'eave'.

The station is a plain unlit brown box. The intent is a glazed, lit station plus a lit cabin and a cable line climbing to (96,60,120). Add the cabin and a cable proxy (emissive line or cabin about 10-20 m up the cable), and make the station glazing the brightest thing on the terrace. Without them the reveal camera has nothing to see.

12 toro at y 35.6, spacing [8,11], plus 13 posts at y 24.5, spacing [7,9], form two even parallel pickets for 60 m with nothing between them. Use spacing [5,16] with clusters of 2-3 at the cable station and the east lookout, leave dark gaps of 15 m or more, and end the walk with the bench lit brighter.

Produced zero pines: the avoid buffer of 6.0 plus the nav band leaves no room. Lower the buffer to 2.0 and place 3-4 windswept pines on the cliff edge at x about 100, 118 and 140 to break the barren east run. Only 2 rock clusters exist on 120 m of edge.

The post at (42.5,25) and the toro lights4:1 (44,31) stand right in front of the concept and overlook camera and block the view down to the pools. Keep the rail posts at the overlook ends (31.2 and 49.3) only.

top_change: Build and light the cable cabin and its cable so that a vertical line of light climbs the cliff from the station: without it the terrace has no focal point at all.
plausibility: Hanging lanterns float about 1.2 m off the cable station.
Cliff-edge railings are 1.5 m segments with 3-5 m gaps (dressing[0], [1], [5], [6]) and resolve at z 1.1, and no railing is visible in any frame. Check the origin convention and make them continuous.
The reveal camera targets z 30 where no geometry exists.
